changes.comment: The Feishu extension api's `FeishuInstanceApi` has no `submitToTeam`, and `sendCard` takes no `mode` field. A card action handler returns `{ response, forward? }`: `response` answers the card callback, and `forward`, when present, states text to deliver to the conversation's Team — Feishu resolves that Team from the card and delivers it through the same path an ask-user answer takes, so no extension holds Team-resolution or delivery logic of its own.
